meta.name: connect
meta.description: Configure or diagnose access to a requested source using available host tools. Use for source MCP setup; source configuration needs no engagement record and credentials stay with the host.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把外部数据源接通到你的智能助手,连不上时帮你排查原因
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让助手读取某个数据源,却卡在配置或权限上。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to reach a data source but are stuck on setup or permissions.

howto.what: 当你要接入某个数据源时,Claude 会用宿主已有的工具配置或排查它的访问,包括 source MCP 设置。凭据留在宿主侧,这类配置不需要 engagement 记录。
howto.when: 当你要求配置或排查某个数据源的访问(如 MCP 设置)时接管;若由 @fde 调用,则复用它当前的净化数据包和范围,不重启设置、不重复提问。

say.text: 帮我配置一下这个数据源的 MCP 访问。
say.note: 用宿主工具配置,凭据不离开宿主。

say.text: 检查一下我对这个数据源的访问是否正常。
say.note: 只做诊断,不写 engagement 记录。

say.text: 这个数据源连不上,帮我排查原因。
say.note: 缺能力或没跑的检查会如实说明。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude configures or diagnoses access to a requested source using the host's available tools, including source MCP setup. Credentials stay with the host, and source configuration needs no engagement record.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to configure or diagnose access to a source, such as MCP setup. If invoked by @fde, it reuses that current sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup or repeats.

say_en.text: Set up MCP access for this data source.
say_en.note: Uses host tools; credentials stay with the host.

say_en.text: Check whether my access to this source works.
This source won't connect — help me diagnose it.
